name: Twilight Library
tagline: A candlelit reading room, small enough to live between your books.
description: Make a little room for imagination. Build a miniature library to sit between your favourite books: a quiet project for slow afternoons and a thoughtful detail for a collected home. This wooden DIY kit has 194 pieces and battery-powered lighting with a touch switch. Assembly is required; the supplier recommends ages 14 and over and estimates 2–3 hours to build. The assembled scene measures 12 cm wide × 10.5 cm deep × 17.5 cm high. Curated by Clara Mendes and supplied in the manufacturer's packaging.
details: Wooden DIY kit; assembly required. Build time is the supplier's estimate. Curated by Clara Mendes and supplied in the manufacturer's packaging.
